`ELEPHC_ORACLE_WHICH` is a migration tool: it runs only when someone sets two environment
variables, so after the conversion lands nothing checks the builder again — and the PHP reference
becomes dead code, which is exactly what the compiler just warned about. A reference nothing reads
rots, and a builder nothing compares drifts.

PDO already solved this: `built_declarations_match_the_php_for_every_profile` is an ordinary test.
